'''Launch Bay 4061''' was a [[Starship/Legends|ship]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]] in [[Worlport/Legends|Worlport]] on [[Ord Mantell/Legends|Ord Mantell]], where tenders and boarding [[Shuttle/Legends|shuttles]] including the ''[[Queen of Empire]]'' were set to leave from when [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] had booked passage to [[Bilbringi system/Legends|Bilbringi]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].
